tys_eyes_20261105.status: DONE - Tys Assistant and Ty's Vision are enabled independently and work together: the eye looks at what a step produced, records a verdict, and hands the assistant guidance it can act on. Cobalt ring while armed. 32 new tests + 274 regression, UI build green, live model verified.
tys_eyes_20261105.owner_brief: Owner wants Tys Assistant enabled first, then its Vision, with the two working together as the assistant's eyes - judging whether it is staying on track and helping it learn (REA) and improve.

built.eye: Northstar_backend/agent_kernel/eye.py - TyEye.look(goal, image, constraint) -> on_track / off_track / unverified / disabled + guidance; append-only JSONL journal; never raises; enabled may be a callable so a toggle applies without a rebuild
built.acceptance_kind: agent_kernel/verify.py registered verifier 'vision' - pass / fail / unknown; unknown never upgraded to pass
built.wiring: tys_assistant._look_at_step - every step that produced an image gets one look; verdict + guidance attached to step evidence and written as an eyes_look event; steps with no image get no look and no invented verdict
built.enforcement: step.params.eyes_enforce (off by default) lets an off_track look fail the step as retriable so the assistant repairs it; step.params.eyes.constraint names the exact thing that must be visible
built.switches: tys_settings table + settings API; assistant.enabled default true (unchanged behaviour), vision.enabled default false; vision refuses to arm while the assistant is off and the assistant switching off disarms vision
built.api: GET/POST /api/admin/tys/switches, GET /api/admin/tys/voice; unknown switch names refused; admin-only
built.ring: northstar-os-ui/src/components/VisionRing.jsx + app.css - fixed full-viewport cobalt ring, pointer-events none, opacity-only compositor animation, 15 s poll paused when hidden, stops on 401/403/404, honours prefers-reduced-motion
built.voice: PERSONA_TEXT + EYES_CONTRACT + LEARNING_LANES in tys_assistant, served in identity()/state and GET /voice; eyes_sentence() narrates only real journal records; panel shows the persona and the last look

on_goal.constraint: a stand-up pouch with a printed front label is visible

off_goal.constraint: a human hand is holding the pouch
off_goal.reasons: the pouch sits on a surface with no visible hand

live_measurements.enforced: eyes_enforce=true -> ok=False, retriable=True, detail carries the guidance

tests.vision_wired_regression: 177 passed (test_tys_routing, test_tys_ops, test_agent_kernel, test_tys_kernel_integration, test_vision_verify) + 97 passed (test_tys_assistant, test_continuous_loop, test_module_hygiene, test_tys_memory_lifecycle)

design_rules: unverified is never upgraded to on_track
a step with no image gets no look and no invented verdict
the eye judges appearance, never source code; fine print goes to OCR and code is read from disk
enforcement is opt-in per step so a 4B model cannot silently block a build by default
the ring is driven by the server switch, not local state
learning recommendations name only the four sanctioned REA paths and their hard never
tys_eyes_20261105.freeze_reconciliation: V3 hard-freeze rule 1: this is an owner-requested capability, admin/operator only, no customer-facing surface; tests for the touched modules are green. Recorded so the freeze is not quietly reinterpreted.
tys_eyes_20261105.boundaries: Local lane only. No Amazon request, no spend, no cloud inference, no credential read, no policy or allowlist change. GPU idle after the live looks.
